theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V C Y : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (L : NNReal) (a b c c' : ℝ) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (w : Euclid P → ℝ) (W : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → IsCompact C → C ⊆ V → MeasurableSet Y → Y ⊆ C → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → (∀ y ∈ Y, f (ψ y) = F y) → (∀ y ∈ Y, G (ψ y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (G (ψ y)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → Measurable G → LipschitzWith L f → a < b → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (hs k)) → (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ c) → TendstoUniformly hs (fun x => min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a)))) atTop → IntegrableOn w (ψ '' Y) μHE[n + 1] → Measurable W → (∀ x, ‖W x‖ ≤ c') → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict (ψ '' Y)), ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → W x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ψ '' Y, w x * fderiv ℝ (hs k) x (W x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in ψ '' Y ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}, w x * (-(b - a)⁻¹ * inner ℝ (G x) (W x)) ∂μHE[n + 1]))
